questions.stem: According to the passage, what movie was shown at the knitting event described at the start of the passage?
options: Titanic
The Devil Wears Prada
La La Land
Frozen
questions.evidence: they watched a movie together called The Devil Wears Prada
questions.explanation_ko: 뜨개질 모임에서 함께 본 영화는 The Devil Wears Prada라고 나와 있습니다.

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT mentioned as something people do while watching movies at these events?
options: Knitting
Crocheting
Breastfeeding babies
Playing video games
questions.evidence: People are knitting, eating, or even breastfeeding babies while watching a movie.
questions.explanation_ko: 뜨개질, 코바늘 뜨개질, 음식 먹기, 아기에게 모유 수유는 언급되지만 비디오 게임은 언급되지 않았습니다.

questions.stem: What can be inferred from the fact that the Vienna organizers based their event on similar ones in the U.S., Northern Europe, Germany, and France?
options: Knitting-while-watching-movies events are unique to Vienna and have not spread elsewhere.
The trend of combining knitting with movie-watching appears to be part of a broader international movement.
This type of event has only ever been tried once, in Austria.
Movie theaters generally discourage any activity besides watching the film.
questions.evidence: Organizers based their event on similar ones in the United States, Northern Europe, Germany and France.
questions.explanation_ko: 미국, 북유럽, 독일, 프랑스의 비슷한 행사를 참고해 만들었다는 내용에서, 이 흐름이 비엔나만의 것이 아니라 더 넓은 국제적 흐름의 일부임을 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author mention that Palmer advises avoiding scary movies at these events?
options: To illustrate a practical concern: sudden frights can cause knitters to lose their place in their work
To criticize horror films in general
To explain the history of horror movies
To argue that all movies shown must be comedies
questions.evidence: They can make you jump causing you to lose your place in your knitting.
questions.explanation_ko: 이 설명은 갑작스러운 놀람이 뜨개질하던 자리를 잃게 만들 수 있다는 실용적인 이유를 보여 주기 위한 것입니다.

questions.stem: In the passage, what does "takes a back seat" mean in "The film takes a back seat, meaning it is less important than the work of knitting"?
options: becomes the main focus of attention
becomes less important than something else
is removed from the schedule entirely
is shown at a higher volume
questions.evidence: The film takes a back seat, meaning it is less important than the work of knitting or crocheting.
questions.explanation_ko: takes a back seat는 다른 것보다 덜 중요해진다는 뜻입니다.

blanks.sentence_ko: 영화를 보며 뜨개질하거나 코바늘 뜨개질하는 것이 유럽에서 인기를 얻고 있다.
그것들은 사람들을 놀라게 해서 뜨개질하던 자리를 잃게 만들 수 있다.
어떤 이들은 이 행사가 컴퓨터 화면이 아닌 진짜와 다시 연결되게 해 준다고 말한다.
다른 이들은 조금 속도를 늦출 수 있다고 말한다.

key_points: Knitting or crocheting while watching movies has become popular in Europe, with events like one in Vienna drawing nearly 200 people to watch films such as The Devil Wears Prada together.
The Vienna events, started by organizer Luisa Palmer, grew partly out of habits people developed knitting alone during COVID-19 lockdowns.
A soft light is kept on during the films to prevent knitting mistakes and encourage interaction, and experienced knitters help beginners learn.
Attendees say the events help them reconnect with something real away from screens, slow down, and find a rewarding, hands-on alternative to computer work.
main_idea: Knitting and crocheting while watching movies together has become a popular social trend in Europe, offering people a relaxing, hands-on alternative to screen time.
restate_sentence: Knitting or crocheting while watching movies has gained popularity in Europe.
